name: Digg

sources.title: About Digg — relaunched as a curated tech-news aggregator watching 'a ranked network of technology voices' on X; 'feed is free and needs no account'
Digg homepage — topic feeds (tech, gaming, AI, etc.) aggregating source posts from X accounts

requirements: No submission form — the relaunched Digg (Digg Inc. / Basic Intelligence) auto-aggregates what 'credible people in tech and AI' post on X
There is no direct way to submit a link; stories enter the feed when accounts in Digg's ranked network post/discuss them
Accounts on digg.com are 'for taking part, not for getting in' — the feed is free and read-only without one
A /contact page exists for reaching the operators
preparation: The realistic route is indirect: get people in the tech/AI X network talking about the product — Digg picks up the signal
A story on a credible publication or a post from a followed account is the raw material
workflow: There is no submission step — publish/post the news where Digg's watched network will see it (X posts by credible tech accounts)
Optionally reach the operators via https://digg.com/contact to flag the product
If a story about the product trends among the tracked voices, it appears on digg.com topic pages
watchFor: This is NOT the old submit-and-vote Digg — no user submissions exist in the current product
Appearing on Digg is a side effect of traction elsewhere, not a launch destination action
Public ranking/feed data is available at digg.com/llms.txt for verification
countsAsLive: A story about the product appears as a story page on digg.com/<topic>/<id> with linked source posts
unknowns: How to get added to Digg's ranked network of watched accounts
Whether the /contact page accepts story suggestions
